IndianOil supplies fuels strictly in accordance with IS 17021:2018 specifications and all applicable quality standards. E20 fuel is a homogeneous, scientifically validated product specifically designed for safe vehicular use. IndianOil strongly advises customers not to rely on or circulate unverified messages.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I had an extremely frustrating experience at Thane east CNG station yesterday. After waiting in a long queue, I was told the pressure was only 180, but I agreed to fill up anyway. The attendant, however, didn’t fit the gas pipe properly, causing gas to leak out. I was the one who had to be informed by another person, while the attendant was completely oblivious. By the time he realized, my reading was 202. Then, after some back-and-forth with another person, Naseer, they refilled it and the final reading was 200.

To my surprise, I was still asked to pay ₹402 even though it was clear half the gas had leaked out because of their mistake. Why should I pay full price for their incompetence? After a long argument, I agreed to pay ₹360, but I shouldn’t have had to pay extra for gas I didn’t even get.

What really pissed me off was how a bunch of the workers had the nerve to make sarcastic and rude comments, saying things like “Jao 40 ka ration bharwalo” and “40 nahi diya, apka 400 ka nuksan hoga.” Seriously? This isn’t about the money, it’s about your employees being careless and then behaving rudely. If your staff can’t do their job properly or treat customers with basic respect, they shouldn’t be in business at all.

-Jai Maharashtra.
